sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Battles inside Bastion Remnants and Nether Fortresses (and their variants).

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Beat Up, Fell Stinger, Pay Day, Pursuit, and Reversal: 2× stronger.

Bone Club, Bone Rush, Bonemerang, Brutal Swing, Bullet Punch, Clanging Scales, Clangorous Soulblaze, Electroweb, First Impression, Leaf Blade, Meteor Assault, Meteor Mash, Night Slash, Payback, Psycho Cut, Punishment, Sacred Sword, Secret Sword, Smack Down, Smart Strike, Steamroller, Submission, and Vine Whip: 1.5× stronger.

Anchor Shot, Crabhammer, Dragon Hammer, Drill Peck, Drill Run, Fire Lash, Ice Hammer, Icicle Spear, Power Whip, Shadow Bone, Spirit Shackle, Storm Throw, Sucker Punch, Throat Chop, and Wood Hammer: 1.2× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Steel-type.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Battle Armor or Shell Armor: Defense +1 when it enters.
Justified or No Guard: Attack +1 and Special Attack +1 when it enters.
Magic Guard: Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Wonder Guard also protects against the field's own damage.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Attack +1 and is taunted.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
